answer: A bank of pre-written answers therefore has nothing to key against, and filling 65 aliases means authoring 65 texts that each match their own nonce. Because the derivation is bound to the nectar signature, the delta gate rejects a mismatch, and the trellis checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. Each challenge carries a 105 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
